 Follow Why Sonny May Not Be Behind the Pier Shooting on GH
 Rachelle Lewis Thu, November 19, 2026 at 7:15 PM UTC 3 min read Add Yahoo as a preferred source to see more of our stories on Google. Image Credit: ABC General Hospital has once again put Sonny in the hot seat thanks to the shooting on the pier where Josslyn or Hudson was the target. Sonny's certainly an obvious choice given that he told Ric that Hudson needed to be taken out. However, there are also good reasons why he wasn't the one behind the hit.
 The Jude Factor
 Jude (Wil Traval) has no love for his cousin Josslyn (Eden McCoy); aside from the fact that Josslyn's running JJE, Jude hasn't been thrilled with her behavior toward him.
 Josslyn has his number after she learned Jax (Ingo Rademacher) fired Jude from JJE for taking bribes but set up a trust for Jude's future children; enter Phoebe (Lucia and Luna Creighton). Jude was furious following his chat with his cousin and basically told Carly (Laura Wright) he was coming for her daughter.
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement It would be so Jerry Jax's (Sebastian Roché) son to try and take out his cousin. Jude just got to town, so it's not like he would be suspect number one. Plus, he knows about the drama between Sonny (Maurice Benard) and Josslyn.
 There's also the factor that Hudson (Troy Lennon Appel) could have been Jude's target. GH fans don't know much about Hudson and Jude's relationship, but there could be a chance Hudson knows something that could come back to bite Jude.
 Whether Josslyn or Hudson was the target, Jude can't be ruled out as being behind the shooting.
 The Timing Doesn't Add Up
 Sonny ordered Ric (Rick Hearst) to have Hudson taken out, and he needed it to happen immediately to solve his Josslyn problem . The former mob boss needs to focus on Ava (Maura West) and Drew (Cameron Mathison) getting married for Avery's (Ayla Bullington).
 Advertisement Advertisement However, could Ric really have gotten the details in place that quickly? The timing of it seems way too fast even for Sonny and Ric, as the gunman seemed to know exactly when Josslyn and Hudson would be on the piers.
 Unless Sonny had someone following Josslyn, how would he know where to find her in the middle of the day? Something just doesn't add up.
 GH going from Sonny ordering Ric to make it happen to having the shooting happen moments later was too fast, especially since it's not like Jason (Steve Burton) was on hand to do the job.
 Then again, would GH really create a scenario where Sonny was framed for two different things at once? It might seem ridiculous, but with everyone turning on Sonny, that could be a new storyline focus.
 Advertisement Advertisement One more prospect is someone from the five families taking revenge on Josslyn for getting the piers. Let's not forget that her winning the bid for the piers didn't just anger Sonny, Drew, and Valentin (James Patrick Stuart). Brad (Parry Shen) and Selena (Lydia Look) were also at that auction.
 Do you think it was Sonny or someone else behind the shooting at the pier?
